chunks.arabic_text: وَسَأَلَ ٱلْحَسَنُ ٱلتَّفْلِيسِيُّ ٱلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ:

translations.en: Al-Hasan al-Taflisi asked al-Ridha عليه السلام:
Can a man engage in mut'ah with a Jewish or Christian woman?

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو ٱلْحَسَنِ ٱلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ: «يَتَمَتَّعُ مِنَ ٱلْحُرَّةِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَةِ وَهِيَ أَعْظَمُ حُرْمَةً مِنْهَا».

translations.en: Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha عليه السلام said: "He should engage in mut'ah with a free believing woman, and she possesses greater sanctity than her."

en.summary: This hadith addresses a legal question concerning mut'ah with Jewish and Christian women. Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام directs the questioner toward mut'ah with a free believing woman, emphasizing her greater sanctity and status. The report reflects a juristic preference within the law of temporary marriage.
en.seo_question: Can a man contract mut'ah with a Jewish or Christian woman according to Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام?

key_terms.يَتَمَتَّعُ: contracts or engages in mut'ah (temporary marriage)
key_terms.ٱلْحُرَّةِ: a free woman, not a bondwoman
key_terms.حُرْمَةً: sanctity, inviolable status, or honored standing
